title: Sealing means for a vacuum gripping device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: SEALING MEANS FOR A VACUUM GRIPPING PAD COMPRISING, A FLEXIBLE RING SECURED TO THE GRIPPING FACE OF SAID PAD AND EXTENDING CONTINUOUSLY AROUND THE PAD ADJACENT THE PERIPHERY THEREOF
features.note: The reference discloses a flexible ring (seal) secured to a gripping pad (carrier plate) and extending continuously around it, but it does not explicitly mention a 'suction plate' as a distinct component.
